summary: This code snippet declares three private constants that store the configuration needed to connect to a SQL Server database and run a query. These constants hold the server address, database name, and SQL command that will be used together to fetch customer data.

explanations.1: This defines the location of the SQL Server: 'localhost' means the database is on your own computer, and '1433' is the port number where SQL Server listens for connections.
explanations.2: This names the specific database within the SQL Server instance that you want to connect to—think of it as selecting which filing cabinet to open.
explanations.3: This stores the actual SQL query that will be executed; in this case, it retrieves all columns and rows from the Customers table in the dbo schema.
